set.body:
Context

fmrialigned PRD gate UP-FMRIREG-002 treats this as a recommended nonblocking upstream repair because a verified SE-based fallback is available.

Observed defect

In R/contrasts_api.R, .normalize_contrasts_for_engine() calls w <- as.numeric(w) before reading names(w) or attr(w, "colind"). Numeric coercion strips both attributes, so the documented named-subset and colind-subset paths are unreachable.

Verified reproduction

With a two-column full-rank design and fmri_ols_fit output:
- t_contrasts = list(x_only = c(x = 1)) fails as not named or length p.
- t_contrasts = list(x_only = structure(1, colind = 2L)) fails the same way.
- the equivalent full-length c(0, 1) succeeds.
- with drop_failed = TRUE, a valid subset contrast may be silently omitted and return an empty result.

Required work

Preserve and validate names and colind before numeric coercion, then normalize the numeric values without losing the resolved coefficient indices. Keep unknown names and malformed indices fail-closed.

Acceptance criteria

- Named-subset, colind-subset, and equivalent full-length t contrasts produce identical estimate, SE, statistic, probability, and df.
- Unknown coefficient names and out-of-range colind values fail with precise errors.
- drop_failed = TRUE never silently drops a valid named or colind contrast.
- Regression tests exercise compute_lm_contrasts() and compute_lm_contrasts_from_suffstats().
- Results agree with an independent lm.fit or pivoted-QR oracle within declared relative and absolute tolerances.
- Existing full-length t and F contrast tests remain green.
set.title: Preserve named and colind subset t-contrasts in compute_lm_contrasts
